_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/zones/test_search_split_destinations.py. t_ssd_cultivate is Cultivate written as one split search (one basic onto the battlefield tapped, the other to hand); t_ssd_grave splits the other way, one to hand and the rest to the graveyard (Intuition's destinations, chosen by the searcher).

cards.name: Test Split Cultivate
cards.oracle_text: Search your library for up to two basic land cards, reveal those cards, put one onto the battlefield tapped and the other into your hand, then shuffle.

cards.name: Test Split Graveyard
cards.oracle_text: Search your library for three cards, put one of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard, then shuffle.
